title: Thick of It (Brainrot Version)
blurb: KSI made a chart hit; the internet put it in a blender and served the results to an entire school year. The brainrot edition replaces the lyrics with pure meme vocabulary — skibidi, sigma, gyatt, all present and accounted for — and deep-fries the audio well past the point of legibility. It is the definitive example of what happens when a genuinely successful song meets a generation that treats everything as raw material. The original charted worldwide. This version made classrooms briefly ungovernable, which is arguably the greater achievement.
origin: The brainrot-lyric remix of KSI's Thick of It.
